phrases.balance_readings_conflict: readings of the same opening or closing balance that disagree

translation_input.prompt:
Translate each value below into Korean, for a note a US tax preparer (CPA) sends a client about items reviewed on a foreign-account worksheet.

Rules:
- Return exactly the same JSON keys, each value translated. No advice, numbers, dates, names or additional facts.
- Every value is a label or noun phrase, NOT a sentence asserting that an action was completed. Keep it plural-safe when several flags of the same kind occur. Do not use semicolons or line breaks.
- Speak to the reader as "your", never "the client". Do not say documents were requested, items matched, or ownership confirmed.
- Use the IRS Korean glossary (Publication 850 EN-KR, September 2023) terms where applicable: account = 계좌; account statement = 계좌 명세서; balance = 잔고; certified public accountant = 공인회계사; Department of the Treasury (U.S.) = 미국 재무부; foreign account = 해외 계좌. These are verified glossary entries. Use ordinary Korean for terms the glossary does not contain.

Phrases:
{
 "balance_readings_conflict": "readings of the same opening or closing balance that disagree"
}
